question_pt: Qual a distribuicao das internacoes por carater de atendimento?
sql: SELECT c."DESCRICAO" AS carater_atendimento, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN car_int c ON i."CAR_INT" = c."CAR_INT" GROUP BY c."DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC
